verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the draft option grant API, which describes grants that have 'not yet received board consent and approval'. That implies board approval is tracked as a status tied to specific equity transactions. Nothing shows Carta drafting consent documents, routing them for e-signature, handling stockholder approvals, or archiving signed consents. Missing for 10: board consent drafting, stockholder approval workflows, e-signature routing, an archive of signed consents linked to transactions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
